mood.label: CAUTIOUSLY-RISK-OFF
mood.summary: Global semiconductor rout spooks markets ahead of the Fed decision tomorrow. Rotation into defensive sectors is evident as technology shares come under pressure on AI spending concerns.

indicesNarrative: US futures are mixed, with a clear divergence as the Nasdaq is weighed down by a significant sell-off in semiconductor stocks. [14] The Dow is holding up better, supported by defensive rotation. The VIX remains subdued below 20, but the underlying sector rotation points to a cautious, risk-off tone as traders await the Fed's decision tomorrow. [3, 10]
technicalsNarrative: Technical data unavailable. The key feature on the tape is the divergence between tech and the broader market, suggesting a flight to safety. Chasing technology stocks is ill-advised until the sector finds support.
